pages.text: Place an accelerator directly beside, above or below a centrifuge. No power is required, and one accelerator may serve several adjacent centrifuges.$(br2)The four tiers reduce recipe processing time to $(thing)65%, 35%, 15% and 10%$() of normal. The centrifuge speed configuration still applies; fractional processing intervals round up.

Only the highest adjacent tier applies; accelerators do not stack. The effect is determined when each operation begins. Placing or removing one during processing affects the next operation.$(br2)The tiers use Ash Steel, Ash Steel Structural Components, Tungsten with Uranium, and Titanium. Higher tiers consume the previous tier.
